resolvedFindings.resolution: Passwords generated and used only inside the page; owner and outsider API requests are real same-origin fetches with 5-second deadlines, returning only status/report/version or status fields. No credential is supplied as a Playwright argument or returned to its reporter.

inspectedBoundaries.finding: No browser route, API, persistence or native execution double. Back is configured for dedicated HTTPS, removed from sandbox network; gateway runs the byte-identical existing nginx template and must share the actual Front image ID. Native upstream remains the existing privileged service. Real public/final runs, 6 public checks, 11 final checks, persisted reload/version and outsider 404 are asserted.

Back Dockerfile USER node; generated mounted files mode 0444 avoids host-runner UID mismatch. Host temporary parent mode 0700 and exact read-only per-service mounts protect identities. CA private key is not mounted; Back and nginx receive only their own private key. Expected bind-mount readability follows the file mode; actual container readability remains required CI.

Server certificate SAN, Docker alias, HTTPS origin and checked servername all equal vibe-executor.internal. Exact nginx paths match mounts and ssl_verify_client remains on. Seven probes each have 4-second deadlines and explicit success/denial expectations; unexpected outcomes fail.

Gateway unprivileged, no published port, read-only filesystem, bounded tmpfs, 128 MiB memory, 0.25 CPU and 32 PID limits. No extra privileged executor, production operation or paid provider. OPENAI_API_KEY explicitly empty and email disabled.

Dedicated API algorithm secret remains distinct. Shared native bearer is synthetic and reused only inside the owned sequential fixture; the documentation does not recommend production credential reuse. 61-second admission idle preserves the existing five-per-minute registration limit.

Browser close is awaited and failure marks the report FAIL. Compose down with volumes is awaited; cleanup failure fails the command and report, followed by owned temporary-key removal. Nested PREFLIGHT_PASS is explicitly distinguished from authoritative final Compose cleanup.

independentlyExecuted.scope: Plan mutations and actual ephemeral certificates; helper unchanged in credential follow-up.

Required jobs, existing timeouts, no-skip rules and strict Runtime gate are unchanged.

limits: Docker/nginx/native/browser execution was not available locally; no new successful chain is claimed before actual CI.
No production host, firewall, certificate rotation, paid evaluator quality, field INP or long-duration editor qualification.
